Physical Microcontroller Deployment

Connect real ESP32 / Arduino / RPi hardware nodes

Supported Physical Sensors:
DHT22 (Temp & Humidity) GPIO 4
BMP280 (Pressure) I2C (SDA 21, SCL 22)
MQ-135 (Air Quality & CO₂) ADC GPIO 34
pH-4502C (Water pH Sensor) ADC GPIO 32
SEN0189 (Water Turbidity) ADC GPIO 33
SEN0244 (TDS Water Meter) ADC GPIO 35
YF-S201 (Water Flow & Leak) Pulse GPIO 23
REST API Telemetry Ingest:
POST http://<PC_IP>:8000/api/telemetry
Content-Type: application/json
{"temp": 24.2, "humidity": 52.0, "aqi": 38, "ph": 7.3, "turbidity": 1.2, "source": "ESP32-Field"}
